name: @mica-js/example-devices
description: Mica 统一器件开发项目集合：一器件一 package，聚合 prepare/build/typecheck 与板级测试

scripts.typecheck: node scripts/for-each-device.mjs prepare && node scripts/for-each-device.mjs typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir ../ideal-led run build && vitest run
scripts.bench: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir ../ideal-led run build && vitest run --config vitest.perf.config.ts
